title: 12 Best Tea Houses in Almaty
description: Discover Almaty's best tea houses for an authentic experience. From traditional Central Asian chaihanas to modern cafes, find your perfect spot for a cup of tea in 2026.

places.name: NAVAT
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pot of fragrant Black Tea with Lemon and a plate of 'Baursaki' (fried dough puffs) or their famous 'Plov'.

places.name: Kishlak
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pot of 'Kok Choy' (Green Tea) and 'Samsa' (flaky meat pastries) baked in a traditional tandoor oven.

places.name: Dastarkhan
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Milk Tea' (Sut Chai) or a pot of classic Black Tea, accompanied by 'Manty' (steamed dumplings).

places.name: Chaikhana Izumrud
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic 'Chai' (Black Tea) and a plate of local pastries like 'Chebureki' or 'Pirozhki'.

places.name: Bukhara
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their specialty 'Green Tea with Herbs' and 'Shashlyk' (skewered meat) for a full meal.

places.name: Mado
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic 'Turkish Tea' (Cay) served in small tulip-shaped glasses, paired with 'Baklava' or 'Kunefe'.

places.name: Chaikhana Rumi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pot of 'Fruit Tea' or 'Herbal Tea' along with some 'Khachapuri' (cheese bread).

places.name: Tarih
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Traditional 'Kazakh Tea' (often served with milk) and 'Kazy' (horse meat sausage) if you're feeling adventurous, or 'Borsok' (fried bread).

places.name: Turandot
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Oolong Tea' selection or a 'Jasmine Green Tea', paired with some delicate dim sum or Asian desserts.

places.name: Chaikhana Plov Centralny
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A plate of their signature 'Plov' (available in various types) and a pot of 'Uzbek Black Tea'.

places.name: Sufi Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their 'Herbal Infusions' or 'Green Teas' with a vegetarian wrap or homemade pastry.

places.name: Altyn Asyr
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pot of robust 'Black Tea' and a plate of 'Baursaki' or 'Kuyrdak' (fried meat and potatoes).
